name: echo-forge-launch
description: Drip campaign for two products: echo-ai (smart AI chat with provider tiers) and forge (solo-dev OSS CLI tooling built in the open). Authentic build-in-public tone, dev audience.

posts.text:
GPT-4o for every message is wasteful. Gemini Flash for every message misses nuance.

echo-ai auto-routes: Flash for quick lookups, Pro for reasoning, Deep for research. Right model, right cost, every time.

{echo_url} #AItools #buildinpublic

echo-ai has 4 tiers:

⚡ Flash — fast + cheap
🧠 Think — reasoning
🔬 Pro — quality
🌊 Deep — research mode

Auto-routes per query. No manual model-switching.

{echo_url} #AItools #devtools

Why I built echo-ai with 4 provider tiers instead of one model:

Flash: instant answers, pennies per query
Think: multi-step reasoning
Pro: polished, high-quality output
Deep: long-context research mode

The system picks the tier for you based on what you're actually asking. No settings to fiddle with.

Link in bio → {echo_url}

#AItools #buildinpublic #indiehackers #devtools #artificialintelligence #machinelearning #solodev #productdesign

Most AI chat apps send every message to the most expensive model.

echo-ai doesn't. Auto-routing cuts costs without cutting quality.

{echo_url} #AItools #buildinpublic

Lesson from building echo-ai: the hardest part wasn't the AI. It was deciding when NOT to use the big expensive model.

Auto-routing logic took longer to tune than the UI. Still worth it.

{echo_url} #buildinpublic #AItools

echo-ai — AI chat that thinks about which model to use before it answers.

Flash for speed. Deep for research. The right tier chosen automatically.

Built solo. No VC. No hype. Just a tool I wanted to exist.

Try it: {echo_url}

#buildinpublic #indiehackers #AItools #solodev #openai #llm #aiproductivity #techproduct

echo-ai supports multiple providers behind the scenes — not vendor lock-in.

If one goes down or gets expensive, the routing layer absorbs it.

That's the point of tiers. {echo_url} #AItools #devtools

forge: a family of small CLI tools for solo devs.

forge-linkedin, forge-social — real browser automation, no stored passwords, conservative daily caps.

Built in the open. {forge_url} #opensource #buildinpublic #devtools

forge-* philosophy:

- no passwords in repo
- conservative caps (don't get banned)
- real browser (works like a human)
- one tool, one job

Not a growth hack. A pace tool. {forge_url} #devtools #opensource

forge-linkedin: automate LinkedIn at a safe, human pace.

No puppeteer tricks. Actual Chrome session. Connect, view, message — within daily limits that won't get your account flagged.

Solo-built. Open source. {forge_url}

#devtools #opensource #buildinpublic #indiehackers #solodev #linkedinmarketing #automation #nodejs

"safe-pace" is the core constraint for forge-*.

Every tool ships with daily_cap, min_delay, max_delay baked in.

Slow is sustainable. Fast gets you banned. {forge_url} #devtools #buildinpublic

forge tools expose an MCP interface so AI agents can orchestrate them.

Your Claude/Cursor session can trigger a post or a connection request via tool call.

Details: {mcp_url} #devtools #MCP #AIagents

Why open source?

Because the best tools I've used were built by someone who needed them first.

forge-* is my attempt at that. Small, sharp, safe-pace CLI tools. Nothing I wouldn't use myself daily.

Star + follow along: {forge_url}

#opensource #buildinpublic #indiehackers #solodev #devtools #programming #softwareengineering #makerlog

forge-social: post to X + Instagram at a safe pace from the CLI.

No API keys. Real Chrome session. Rate-limited by design.

Building it in the open — {forge_url} #devtools #buildinpublic #opensource

Solo dev thesis: ship small tools that do one thing well.

echo-ai auto-routes AI providers. forge-* automates social at human pace.

No team. No funding. Just usefulness. {forge_url} | {echo_url} #buildinpublic #indiehackers #solodev

This week in the forge-* build:

→ campaign engine for echo-ai + forge posts
→ placeholder system so URLs aren't hardcoded
→ 359 tests green

Slow is steady. {forge_url} #buildinpublic #devlog

Two products, one dev:

echo-ai — smarter AI chat via auto-routing across provider tiers
forge — safe-pace CLI tools for social + networking, built in the open

Both solve problems I had. Both built without a team.

Follow along: {echo_url} | {forge_url}

#buildinpublic #indiehackers #solodev #devtools #AItools #makerlog #indiemaker #sideproject

Real lesson from building forge-social:

Don't optimise for speed. Optimise for not getting banned.

Human-pace automation lasts. Aggressive automation gets accounts nuked.

{forge_url} #buildinpublic #devtools

echo-ai's Deep tier: long-context research mode.

When you need a real answer, not a fast one. Routes to the best available model for the task.
